add_slot.name: Add manual slot
add_slot.description: Override the battery plan with an action state from start to end. The times are rounded out to whole quarters. Where manual slots overlap, the last added wins.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the slot (rounded down to the quarter)

end.name: End
end.description: End of the slot (rounded up to the quarter)

soc.name: Target SOC
soc.description: For 'charge': charge up to it, then hold (default the max SOC). For 'sell': sell down to it, then self-use (default the reserve SOC). Ignored otherwise.

remove_manual_slot.name: Remove manual slot
remove_manual_slot.description: Remove the manual slots that start in the quarter of the given time

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the slot to remove

update_forecast.name: Update forecast
update_forecast.description: Recalculate the load and PV forecast per quarter for today and tomorrow

update_battery_plan.name: Update battery plan
update_battery_plan.description: Recalculate the battery plan from the current forecast, prices and battery state

init.title: Grid tariff
init.description: Network fees, sell compensation and power charges used by the planner.

custom.title: Custom grid tariff
custom.description: YAML with energy_fees and sell_compensation (öre/kWh incl. VAT, matching rules add up) and power_charges (kr/kW per month, peaks = mean of the N highest hourly means, one_per_day). Every rule may limit months (1-12), weekdays (1-7, Monday = 1) and hours ([start, end), may wrap midnight).
